name: effectcraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for EffectCraft: create motion graphics, animated titles and visual effects (text, shapes, media, keyframes, expressions, 306 effects, templates) and render MP4, ProRes, WebM, GIF, image sequences and Lottie with EffectCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . effectcraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)

codex.shortDescription: Motion graphics, titles and effects rendered with your local EffectCraft
defaultPrompt: Make a 5-second animated intro with my logo and a glowing title
Add a lower third with a name and role over this video
Render this .ecproj comp as MP4 and as a GIF
